goal: Turn multiple independent national hydrologic and weather feeds into a trustworthy answer to: Is this waterfall visually worth visiting now, and is the flow likely to improve over the next three days?
hard_vetoes: Do not choose a gauge by straight-line distance when NLDI network linkage is available.
Do not label National Water Model guidance as an official NWS forecast.
Do not present spectacle score as safety or access advice.
Do not invent live flow, rainfall, historical percentile, or regulation data when a source fails.
Do not retain high confidence when connected observations or seasonal history are absent.
Do not allow upstream regulation detection to increase confidence.

benchmark_cases.name: free-flowing gauged waterfall
benchmark_cases.required: NLDI + NWM + connected USGS gauge + seasonal daily history + NWS QPF; confidence High when all current

benchmark_cases.name: ungauged waterfall
benchmark_cases.required: NLDI + local NWM + NWS QPF; score may render but confidence Low and observation absence disclosed

benchmark_cases.name: regulated waterfall
benchmark_cases.required: upstream dam/reservoir disclosure; confidence penalty; no claim releases are known

benchmark_cases.name: high-water spectacle
benchmark_cases.required: high spectacle may coexist with elevated safety caution

benchmark_cases.name: source outage
benchmark_cases.required: partial result degrades explicitly; never substitute fabricated values

benchmark_cases.name: wrong-basin-nearby-gauge trap
benchmark_cases.required: network-connected gauge only; geographic-nearest shortcut forbidden

launch_metrics.mobile_target: first decision visible without horizontal scroll at 390px
launch_metrics.seo_target: canonical tool page indexable; API endpoints noindex
